document: The APXM benchmark harness orchestrates LLM workload measurements end to end. It launches one or more tenant subprocesses per cell, each running an APXM graph script with a per-tenant variant index. The driver synthesizes prompts deterministically so prefix-cache structure can be reasoned about offline, and the per-batch CSV records wall-clock, per-tenant latency, pin metadata pulled from /v1/apxm/graphs/, and Prometheus prefix-cache hit-rate deltas. Cells are isolated by cache reset between cold runs. Pre-registration files must land before any claim-bearing run.

document: vLLM's RadixAttention stores attention KV blocks keyed by prompt prefix so requests sharing a prefix reuse the cached blocks. The APXM fork extends this with a pin mechanism: requests whose graph metadata says they belong to a critical-path cohort can pin their KV blocks against eviction under memory pressure. Pin engagement requires (1) prefix caching ON, (2) KV utilization above _APXM_PIN_ALLOW_USAGE (default 0.85), (3) scheduling-policy=priority, and (4) live queue contention. When all four are met, the scheduler defers non-critical work and reports pinned_blocks_peak in the graph status response.
